02 — The Fuel

The Plate

Protein2 palm portions
VegetablesHalf the plate
Starch1 cupped hand
Protein target / day130–160g

Protein

  • Beef — ground beef, sirloin, flank steak, stew meat
  • Chicken — breast or thigh
  • Turkey — ground or breast
  • Pork — tenderloin, chops
  • Eggs
  • Greek yogurt or cottage cheese
  • Shrimp or scallops

Vegetables

  • Broccoli
  • Green beans
  • Asparagus
  • Brussels sprouts
  • Zucchini
  • Cauliflower
  • Bell peppers
  • Spinach or mixed greens
  • Cabbage
  • Carrots
  • Snap peas

Starch

  • Rice — white or brown
  • Potatoes — regular or sweet
  • Pasta
  • Quinoa
  • Couscous
  • Farro
  • Whole wheat tortillas
Start5'5" · 206 lbs
Goal175 lbs
Target intake1,500–1,800 kcal/day
Expected pace1–1.5 lbs/week
Timeline~5–7 months
  • Weigh in weekly — same day, same conditions
  • Flat trend 2–3 weeks → shrink starch or add a veggie portion
  • Hungry before next meal → add a cupped hand of carbs
  • Ramen: occasional only — add an extra egg or leftover chicken + frozen veggies when it happens

03 — Mobility

Full Routine, Every Day

Low Lunge
Front knee forward, back knee down, reach both arms overhead.
Hold 30–60 sec each side
Pigeon Pose
Front shin across the mat, back leg extended, fold forward over the front leg.
Hold 30–60 sec each side
Butterfly Pose
Soles of feet together, knees fall open, gentle forward lean.
Hold 30–60 sec
Standing Figure-4
Cross one ankle over the opposite knee, sit back like a chair squat.
Hold 30 sec each side
Lizard Pose
Low lunge, drop both hands (or forearms) inside the front foot.
Hold 30–60 sec each side
Frog Pose
Knees wide on the mat, shins parallel, rock hips back slowly.
Hold 30–60 sec — go slow
Cat–Cow
Hands and knees, arch and round the spine slowly.
8–10 slow reps
Child's Pose
Knees wide, sit back on heels, arms stretched forward.
Hold 30–60 sec
Thread the Needle
On hands and knees, slide one arm under the body, shoulder to the mat.
Hold 30 sec each side
Cobra / Sphinx
Lying face down, press up through the forearms, chest lifts.
Hold 20–30 sec
Seated Spinal Twist
Sit, cross one foot over the opposite knee, twist toward the bent knee.
Hold 20–30 sec each side
Eagle Arms
Cross arms in front, wrap forearms/palms together, lift elbows.
20–30 sec each side
Overhead Triceps Stretch
One arm bent behind the head, other hand gently presses the elbow back.
20–30 sec each side
Doorway Chest Stretch
Forearm on a doorframe, step through slightly to open the chest.
20–30 sec each side
Thumb Tendon Glide
Hand flat, palm up. Slide the thumb across the palm toward the pinky, then back out.
8–12 reps · stop if sharp pain
Thumb Opposition
Touch the thumb tip to each fingertip in turn.
8–10 reps each hand · stop if sharp pain
Wrist Flexor / Extensor Stretch
Arm out, gently press the hand down and back, then flip and repeat palm up.
15–20 sec each way · stop if sharp pain
Thumb Extension Stretch
Palm up, gently pull the thumb back and down toward the wrist.
5–6 sec hold · 8–10 reps · stop if sharp pain
Wrist Circles
Slow, small circles both directions, no load.
10 reps each direction
Downward Dog
Hands and feet down, hips lift up, heels reach toward the floor.
Hold 30–60 sec
Seated Forward Fold
Legs out straight, reach for the feet, back rounded or flat.
Hold 30–60 sec
Reclined Figure-4
Lying down, ankle crossed over the opposite knee, pull that thigh in.
Hold 30 sec each side
Standing Quad Stretch
Grab one ankle behind you, knee pointing down, hold something for balance.
Hold 20–30 sec each side
Wall Calf Stretch
Hands on a wall, one leg back straight, heel down.
Hold 20–30 sec each side
Wide-Leg Forward Fold
Feet wide, hinge forward, hands to the floor or a block.
Hold 30–60 sec

04 — Agility

Every Day

High Knees in Place
Drive the knees up fast, stay light on the feet.
20–30 sec
Lateral Shuffles
Side to side across the room, low athletic stance.
20–30 sec
Quick Feet
Tiny, fast steps in place — hot-coals feet.
20–30 sec
Lateral Lunges
Step wide to the side, sink into one hip, push back to center.
8–10 reps each side
Single-Leg Balance Reach
Stand on one leg, tap the opposite foot forward / side / back, switch.
6–8 reps each direction, each leg
Bodyweight Squat to Reach
Squat down, explode up reaching overhead.
8–10 reps

05 — Strength

3 Rounds, Every Day

Squats
Feet shoulder-width, sit back into the hips, chest up.
15 reps
Push-Ups
Knees down is fine to start — keep the line from head to hips straight.
10 reps
Lunges
Step forward, back knee toward the floor, drive through the front heel.
10 reps per leg
Glute Bridges
Feet planted, drive the hips up, squeeze at the top.
15 reps
Plank
Straight line from head to heels, forearms or hands down.
30 sec hold
Burpees
Squat, kick back to a plank, return, explode up.
8 reps
Weeks 1–2
Numbers above, every day
Every 2 wks
+2–3 reps per move, or +10–15 sec plank
Past 20+ reps
Swap harder variant: decline push-ups, jump squats, walking lunges, plank shoulder taps, burpee + tuck jump
Optional
Table-edge or doorframe rows, if accessible
